dict.heroTag: Airport runs, outstation trips, and city drives across Punjab — driven by someone who knows every shortcut.
dict.aboutHeading1: A driver who knows Punjab's roads like his own street.
dict.aboutPara1: Twelve years of driving across the state — from early-morning airport pickups to late-night highway runs. Every trip is planned around your schedule, not the other way around.
dict.aboutPara2: No surprises, no detours. Just a clean car, a fair fare quoted upfront, and a driver who's on time.
dict.servicesSub: Book for a single trip or a full day — whatever the journey calls for.
dict.svc1Desc: Pickups and drop-offs at Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee (ATQ) Amritsar and Chandigarh airports, timed to your flight.
dict.svc2Desc: One-way or round trips to Amritsar, Chandigarh, Delhi, Manali, or Dharamshala — with rest stops built into the route.
dict.svc3Desc: Half-day or full-day city tours, including temple and gurudwara visits at your own pace.
dict.svc4Desc: Decorated car options and multi-day bookings for baraats, receptions, and family functions.
dict.svc5Desc: Monthly billing available for offices needing regular staff pickups or client transport.
dict.routesSub: Fixed fares, no meter surprises. Ask for a quote on any route not listed here.
dict.vehicleSub: A Suzuki Ertiga, maintained and sanitized before every trip.
dict.feat1: Seats up to 6 passengers comfortably, with luggage space
dict.feat2: Air conditioning running the full trip, front and rear
dict.feat3: Phone charging points and bottled water provided
dict.feat4: Serviced every 5,000 km, insurance up to date
